'''Shields''' are [[weapons]] that can be used with other one-handed weapons. The [[block]] power, [[parry]] force and parry bonus of the weapons used with shields would be replaced by that of the shield used. '''Tower shields''' offer the highest raw block power and force at the cost of usually 10% slower movement (this equally increases dodge roll cost) when in hand compared to other shields' 5%, and no parrying, which allows other shields to achieve higher block armor in parrying. '''Buckler shields''' offer the best parry block armor but the weakest block armor and parry force. '''Iron shield''' is an item. Like all tower shields, it is incapable of parrying and has a dramatic -20% movement speed penalty when drawn, but provides superior block power to other variants.

== Availability ==
Cannot currently be crafted. See [[Iron Tower Shield]] for the available iron tier tower shield.

== Upgrade information ==
Cannot currently be upgraded.

== Notes ==
Currently only obtainable via console commands and does not function properly. Rather than attaching to the hand, it seems to be attached to the air behind the left foot.

The '''knight shield''' is an unused asset with the appearance of a kite shield but the function of a round shield.

== Availability ==
Currently only obtainable via console commands. See [[Banded Shield]] for obtainable iron tier round shield.

== Notes ==
* It is currently not mounted properly in game. When equipped, it clips into the player's arm and when sheathed or blocking it is mounted/held sideways.

[[Mörkhalla]] | usage = Crafting }} }} The '''Nord Greatshield''' is an [[Deep North]]-tier tower [[Shields]]. The '''Nord Greatshield''' currently has the highest block armor value of any shield in the game. It has more block power compared to the [[Nord Shield]] and [[Nord Buckler]], but reduces [[movement speed]] by 10%. As a tower shield, it cannot be used to [[parry]] enemy attacks.
